status: Planning only; no launch, execution approval, implementation or budget reservation.

basis.finding: The old finally only writes evidence, so exceptions can leave its child running. Its outer group excludes adapters started with start_new_session=True. Native fake process-fork denial does not cover the preceding Bash/substitution/dirname chain. Existing coding guardian approval relies on nofork and cannot be transferred to this harness.

smallest_method: One narrowly scoped fixed-command execution-envelope card, provisionally slot35 if the five remaining findings close without consuming it. Implement a two-process root bootstrap/runner in one source file with fixed internal roles, independent deadlines and a private bounded control pipe. Bootstrap owns runner; runner owns each uv/harness leader sequentially. No general controller, arbitrary command/config loader, provider activation, unit tests, or changes to accepted coding controls. A root-authored bootstrap instead of a coding card still requires independent exact-source review and cannot bypass budget policy.
prerequisites: Complete all remaining test findings and independent exact-revision source/environment approval. Frozen28 remains unsafe for execution. Review both actual adapters and generated fake/profile, including every subprocess path; prove all adapter descendants remain in their adapter leader's session/group until exit. Bash may fork: proof concerns group retention, never absence of forks. Any unaccounted setsid/setpgid/daemon escape blocks this method.

Receipt card34 must inventory every attempted bounded_run, including matrix, valid review, invalid arities, lifecycle and deadline paths: scenario/call identity, actual acquired child PID and PGID/session-leader identity, no-child attempts, reap outcome and independent cleanup fields. Source review must establish inventory completeness across spawn handoff and ordinary exception paths. Persist bounded final inventory even for expected failure exits. Missing/truncated inventory after an uncatchable death is uncertainty, not evidence of no descendants.

Bind final immutable manifest, test/adapters, wrapper, uv executable, Python interpreter, pyproject.toml, uv.lock and environment. Verify root's exclusive workflow lock, absence of prior uncertain jobs, fresh owned nonsymlink 0700 output directories, launch/time ledger and remaining execution allowance. Do not edit historical artifacts or reserve a launch from this plan.

fixed_invocation.binding: Substitutions are author-time literals in the independently reviewed final wrapper. Resolve .venv/bin/python and attest its actual executable identity and locked environment; record both paths and hashes. No PATH-selected Python, interpreter download, dependency synchronization, shell interpolation or externally supplied argv. Preflight rejects a different installed uv path rather than silently changing versions.
fixed_invocation.environment: Allowlist PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, private HOME/TMPDIR/UV_CACHE_DIR, LANG=C, UV_OFFLINE=1 and UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never; no provider credentials or inherited configuration. Verify final interpreter accepts -I without changing required public behavior.

bounded_supervision: Freeze an explicit literal list of every public --scenario value from the final reviewed source, with expected outcome/receipt assertions. Current baseline is matrix plus eight lifecycle controls; deadline29 adds two. Include later fixed controls. No scenario discovery by importing candidate code, arbitrary controls or silent skipping. Run sequentially into separate directories.

Runner: matrix deadline 200 seconds; other scenarios 20 seconds unless final source review establishes a larger fixed need. One additional cleanup allowance 5 seconds. Cap retained and observed stdout/stderr at 65536 bytes each; overflow is failure. Nonblocking reads use fixed chunks and saved positive remaining durations. Bound each receipt read at 65537 bytes and records at 16385 bytes; reject overflow before parsing. Bound total scenario count to 32 and total deadline to summed scenario deadlines, cleanup allowances and query allowances plus 30 seconds; reconcile against remaining active allocation before launch.

Install deferred cooperative handlers before acquisition. All setup, collection, exceptions and cleanup enter one protected finalizer. Signal only a currently owned, unreaped direct leader/group; set reap-uncertain before waitpid and never signal after reap or uncertain ownership. Capture independent close/reap/EOF outcomes. On timeout or outer interruption, first give owned harness SIGTERM and a fixed 3-second grace for its reviewed finalizer; SIGKILL only while ownership remains certain. Forced termination always prevents acceptance.

Bootstrap independently bounds runner lifetime and host-facing streams and reacts to control-channel EOF. It may signal only its own unreaped runner. Runner similarly observes bootstrap liveness through the private control pipe. Missing final receipt, bootstrap/runner crash, forced supervisor death or broken acquisition handoff means BLOCKED_CLEANUP_UNCERTAIN. Retain the lock and evidence; stop subsequent scenarios. exec_command completion alone is never acceptance evidence.
descendant_gate: After each harness has exited/reaped and streams reached EOF, bootstrap independently runs fixed /bin/ps -axo pid=,ppid=,pgid= with its own 5-second deadline and 1MiB raw cap. Its subprocess has the same owned-before-reap signaling rule. Validate query success and every row. Compare all inventoried adapter PGIDs plus the uv/harness and runner groups as applicable after each leader's completion.

Accept descendant absence only with a complete source-backed inventory, the reviewed no-group-escape chain, and successful independent observation showing no remaining members. A surviving/reused group number, query failure, inventory omission, unexpected topology or forced death blocks acceptance. PID reuse can cause conservative rejection; it never authorizes signaling. EOF, leader reap and cleanup=success alone do not establish descendant absence.

Never kill saved PIDs/PGIDs, signal after their leaders were reaped, use name-based pkill, or attempt automatic orphan salvage. Uncertain cleanup requires separately reviewed recovery before another launch. This finite contract intentionally reports uncertainty after SIGKILL/interpreter death rather than promising impossible cleanup from lost ownership.
acceptance: Independent root checks must require expected public exit/stdout/stderr and bounded scenario-specific receipts, exact unchanged source/environment bindings, observed direct-child reaps, complete descendant gate and independently completed bootstrap. Expected test failure is distinct from envelope failure; cleanup-interrupt may intentionally report failed cleanup while all actual obligations are independently accounted for. Source closure, wrapper zero exit, or literal success fields alone cannot close a card.
precise_current_blocker: No complete matrix/arity child-group inventory exists in frozen28, and the old wrapper neither protects exception cleanup nor independently supervises itself. Implement the receipt34 prerequisite and the fixed envelope, then obtain separate reviews. No additional general process controller or speculative failure-mode expansion is required.
